Name: sdvconvertergui2
Author: AnotherPillow
Description:
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/urd4nuI.png[/img]
[size=6][b]sdvconvertergui2[/b][/size][/center]

A rewritten GUI for popular Stardew Valley converters.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

It's a portable application (as of now) - there's no installer.

[size=4][b]Usage[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Download the latest release from the files tab.
[*]Run the downloaded file.
[*]Choose a converter and select a [font=Times New Roman]manifest.json[/font] (that works with the converter)
[*]Press the convert button and wait for it to complete.
[*]Your converted mod with be opened in your file manager, and you can press the export button to see a zipped version.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Why no Mac & Linux releases?[/b][/size]

I could not find portable Python and Git releases for them.

[size=4][b]Supported converters[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/AnotherPillow/BFAV2CP]BFAV2CP[/url] by AnotherPillow
[*][url=https://github.com/AnotherPillow/TMXL2CP]TMXL2CP[/url] by AnotherPillow
[*][url=https://github.com/AnotherPillow/CM2CP]CM2CP[/url] by AnotherPillow
[*][url=https://github.com/AnotherPillow/STF2CP]STF2CP[/url] by AnotherPillow
[*][url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/FurnitureConverter]FurnitureConverter[/url] by elizabethcd
[*][url=https://github.com/holy-the-sea/CP2AT]CP2AT[/url] by holy-the-sea
[*][url=https://github.com/AnotherPillow/CPA2SC]CPA2SC[/url] by AnotherPillow
[*][url=https://github.com/AnotherPillow/SAAT2CP]SAAT2CP[/url] by AnotherPillow
[*][url=https://github.com/AnotherPillow/MTN2CP]MTN2CP[/url] by AnotherPillow
[/list]


[size=4][b]Attribution[/b][/size]

All converters are used with permission, and the original authors can be found above.
The main background image is used with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7416]Custom Menu Background[/url].
